scope: Independent read-only adversarial review of constructed R365 data and guard, not a market outcome.
arithmetic: Independent Fraction calculation reproduced all twelve R365 cells; the original signed markout and fee arithmetic in the fixed cases is unchanged.
defects: A quote whose UTC receipt precedes the fill can have a monotonic receipt 10 ms after the fill receipt and still be scored under the tolerated clock drift.

No-fill counts lack a first-seen terminal-receipt clock and evidence that the complete partial-fill history was reconciled. An as-of before anchor or a canceled accepted order can be misreported as no fill.
The entry collateral check omits separately deducted action and extra charges; it does not establish solvency after closing or along the path.
Known no-fill action costs omit requested capital-basis output; the three independently calculated values at $2000 are -0.25, -0.50 and -0.75 bp.
A caller-supplied validated_bbo_mid role does not prove BBO provenance. The 100 paid entry actions omit any incremental action charge on the assumed midpoint exit.
preservation: R365 original spec, code and result remain unchanged. R366 is a separate correction; its source attestation and idealized midpoint exit do not establish executable PnL or path solvency.
